analysis.executiveSummary: This transaction represents a classic win-now consolidation move for Big Balder Brand (Champion Favorite) to secure S-tier dual-threat quarterback Jayden Daniels (95.8 C-AVI) from DMV Fantasy (Retooling). By sending Jaxson Dart (82.1 C-AVI), rising wide receiver Jalen Coker (54.1 C-AVI), a 2027 2nd-round pick, and a distant 2029 1st-round pick, Big Balder Brand elevates its starting QB position by +13.7 C-AVI points without compromising any of its 7 other core offensive starters. For DMV Fantasy, trading Daniels yields a 23-year-old franchise QB in Dart, wide receiver depth in Coker, their own 2027 2nd back, and premium future draft capital that fits their retooling timeline. Market Reality reflects a high 88% acceptance probability, making this an actionable, high-impact deal for a championship-focused roster.
